panels.title: Ledger Build Rate
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*How many new ledgers this node finishes building per second.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second rate of completed ledger-build operations, averaged over 5 minutes and split by node.*

###### Reading it:
*A steady flat line; the value should track the network close cadence.*

###### Healthy range:
*About 0.2-0.3 ledgers/sec on mainnet (roughly one every 3-5s); workload-dependent on test networks.*

###### Watch for:
*A drop toward zero (node fell out of sync or stalled) or a value well above the network rate (rebuilding history).*

###### Source:
[BuildLedger.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp)

###### Function:
`buildLedgerImpl`

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(span_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", span_name="ledger.build"}[$__rate_interval])), "series", "Builds / Sec", "", "")

panels.title: Ledger Build Duration
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*The time taken to build a single ledger, at the 95th percentile.*

###### How it's computed:
*95th-percentile of ledger-build durations over a 5-minute window, per node.*

###### Reading it:
*Lower is better; the line should stay well under the ledger interval.*

###### Healthy range:
*Typically tens to low hundreds of milliseconds; workload-dependent.*

###### Watch for:
*Sustained rises approaching the close interval, which indicate heavy transaction sets or disk/I/O pressure.*

###### Source:
[BuildLedger.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp)

###### Function:
`buildLedgerImpl`

targets.expr: label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(span_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", span_name="ledger.build"}[5m]))), "series", "P95 Build Duration", "", "")

panels.title: Ledger Validation Rate
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*How often ledgers reach full validation (accepted by the trusted validator quorum) per second.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second rate of ledger-validation events over 5 minutes, per node.*

###### Reading it:
*Should closely match the build rate under normal, in-sync operation.*

###### Healthy range:
*About 0.2-0.3/sec on mainnet; workload-dependent elsewhere.*

###### Watch for:
*A validation rate that lags the build rate, signalling the node is building ahead of the network consensus it trusts.*

###### Source:
[LedgerMaster.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/LedgerMaster.cpp)

###### Function:
`LedgerMaster::checkAccept`

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(span_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", span_name="ledger.validate"}[$__rate_interval])), "series", "Validations / Sec", "", "")

panels.title: Ledger Build Duration Heatmap
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*The full distribution of ledger-build times over the window, not just a single percentile.*

###### How it's computed:
*Counts of ledger builds falling in each duration band per 5-minute window, shown as color density.*

###### Reading it:
*A tight low band is healthy; scattered high cells mean occasional slow builds.*

###### Healthy range:
*Most mass concentrated in the low-millisecond bands; workload-dependent.*

###### Watch for:
*A second cluster of hot cells at high durations (bimodal build times) hidden by percentile charts.*

###### Source:
[BuildLedger.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp)

###### Function:
`buildLedgerImpl`

targets.expr: sum(increase(span_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", span_name="ledger.build"}[5m])) by (le)

panels.title: Transaction Apply Duration
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*The time spent applying the agreed transaction set into the new ledger, at the 95th percentile.*

###### How it's computed:
*95th-percentile of transaction-apply durations over 5 minutes, per node.*

###### Reading it:
*Lower is better; this is a large share of total build time.*

###### Healthy range:
*A few to tens of milliseconds; scales with transaction volume per ledger.*

###### Watch for:
*Spikes during large or expensive transaction sets, which push out overall ledger build time.*

###### Source:
[BuildLedger.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp)

###### Function:
`applyTransactions`

targets.expr: label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(span_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", span_name="tx.apply"}[5m]))), "series", "P95 tx.apply", "", "")

panels.title: Transaction Apply Rate
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*How often the transaction-apply phase runs per second (once per ledger build).*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second rate of transaction-apply operations over 5 minutes, per node.*

###### Reading it:
*Should track the ledger build rate almost exactly.*

###### Healthy range:
*About 0.2-0.3/sec on mainnet; workload-dependent.*

###### Watch for:
*Divergence from the build rate, which would indicate a metric or pipeline anomaly.*

###### Source:
[BuildLedger.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp)

###### Function:
`applyTransactions`

panels.title: Ledger Store Rate
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*How often completed ledgers are written into ledger history per second.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second rate of ledger-store operations over 5 minutes, per node.*

###### Reading it:
*Should match the build rate during normal operation.*

###### Healthy range:
*About 0.2-0.3/sec on mainnet; can burst higher while backfilling history.*

###### Watch for:
*A store rate below the build rate (storage falling behind) or a stall at zero.*

###### Source:
[LedgerMaster.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/LedgerMaster.cpp)

###### Function:
`LedgerMaster::storeLedger`

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(span_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", span_name="ledger.store"}[$__rate_interval])), "series", "Stores / Sec", "", "")

panels.title: Build vs Close Duration
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*Ledger build time compared with the total consensus ledger-close time, both at the 95th percentile.*

###### How it's computed:
*Two 95th-percentile duration series over 5 minutes: ledger construction and the full consensus close, per node.*

###### Reading it:
*Build should sit below close; the gap is consensus overhead outside construction.*

###### Healthy range:
*Close a bit above build; both workload-dependent and under the round interval.*

###### Watch for:
*A widening gap (consensus-pipeline overhead growing) or build time approaching close time.*

###### Source:
[BuildLedger.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp) · [RCLConsensus.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp)

###### Function:
`buildLedgerImpl ; RCLConsensus::Adaptor::onClose`

What this shows: Ledger construction, validation, and storage activity and timing for this node.
Use it to: Confirm ledgers are being built, validated, and stored on schedule and find the slow stage when they are not.
